description:
Create a GeoGebra file comparing two mathematical models of the St. Louis Gateway Arch: an inverted catenary (hyperbolic cosine) and a parabola. 

1. Define the catenary function: f(x) = 630 - 128*(cosh(x/128) - 1)
2. Define the parabolic approximation: g(x) = 630*(1 - (x/315)^2)
3. Add a text annotation to the view comparing or labeling the curves.
4. Save the project as 'gateway_arch_comparison.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.

Both curves must be visible in the Graphics View.
